Finance Minister Hails India's 7.8% Economic Growth

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman described India's 7.8% economic growth as 'remarkable' during an investors' meet in the US. She highlighted this achievement in the context of global disruptions. The statement was made at an event attended by investors.
